note: The readiness sample for a views-on root now asks the checkout view for the index it serves for the installed snapshot (building it only when that snapshot has none yet) instead of the owner's scope-wide cache, which a publication resets. Previously a search between a fill's publication and the worker's index rebuild saw no semantic snapshot, planned no semantic lane and answered with lexical hits only. Views-off roots have no checkout view and take the unchanged path, so their ranked rows stay byte-identical; scoring, fusion and paging are untouched.
